title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1979-01-15
source: Recorded by Steve Rolfe: Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-I90/Dolby B); Section 61 Row S Seat 7; Transfer and masteringg by David Minches: Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Korg MR-1000(DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo]) Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96] > Adobe Audition 6.0> FLAC encoding

ai_review.summary: Matrix‑mixed recording captures a soulful Jerry Garcia performance with standout Jack Straw, Row Jimmy and an electric Miracle>Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The show is treasured for its emotional depth – Jerry’s soulful playing shines on a ragged‑glory rendition of Jack Straw, a beloved Row Jimmy, and the electrified Miracle>Shakedown. The matrix mix adds clarity and ambience, making the recording sound full and engaging.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review praises both the performance (especially Jerry) and the matrix mix, indicating an excellent show with high‑quality recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend praised for adding a special quality to the sound; no complaints about clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Emotionally resonant set that feels like a reluctant celebration of the end of the Keith/Donna era, with strong song transitions and heartfelt performances.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Soulful playing highlighted; his tone and emotion are noted as standout.
